protocol: BRIDGRAI-IPR / Padurea de Cod — Stories Manifest
author: Mihai Roșca

method.item_hash: SHA-256 over the exact bytes of each PDF file
method.ordering: items sorted by 'file' (Python str sort, Unicode code point order)
method.master: SHA-256 over ASCII string of item sha256 hex values joined with '|', in listed order
method.verify: 1) sha256 each PDF and compare with its item; 2) recompute master from the item list; 3) read big_map key PDC-STORIES-v1 of the contract on tzkt.io and compare with master
